title: Cozy Pine Cruiser

body: This stunning custom-built camper van showcases the ultimate in off-grid living, designed specifically for a customer who values comfort, sustainability, and adventure. Equipped with a robust 300W solar system, an 800Ah lithium iron battery, and a 3000W UL pure sine wave power inverter/charger, this van offers unparalleled energy independence. With multiple electrical outlets and a 30A shore power plugin, the van is built to handle modern-day electrical needs, making it a perfect travel companion for those long road trips or remote camping spots.

The van's plumbing system is equally impressive, featuring a 30-gallon freshwater tank, electric graywater dump, and a composting toilet set within a wet-bath style indoor shower. Hot water is always at the ready, thanks to the four-gallon electric water heater, which also supplies the outdoor shower at the rear for those days spent exploring the great outdoors.

Inside, the van exudes warmth with wood-stained walls and ceilings, dimmable LED lighting, and a cozy kitchen outfitted with a stainless steel sink, Acacia butcher block countertop, and a portable induction cooktop. The Isotherm fridge/freezer and Zuvo water purifier ensure fresh food and clean water are always available on the road. Ample storage space comes in the form of overhead cabinets, a double-door under-counter cabinet, and a headliner shelf, ensuring there's plenty of room for all your gear.

Designed for adventure, this van features all-terrain rims and tires, a Nomadic electric awning, and bug nets for all windows. The Espar diesel-powered cabin heater keeps things cozy in colder climates, while the Maxxair Deluxe ceiling fan ensures airflow in warmer temperatures. With thoughtful features like a Lagun swivel table, magnetic blackout window coverings, and a full-size bed, this van provides a perfect balance of utility and luxury for the open road.
